name: macOS bootable installer
description: Apple's supported bootable macOS installer workflow for compatible Intel and Apple silicon Macs. Create the installer on a working Mac; it is not a universal image for arbitrary PCs.
license_note: Use Apple's installer and licence terms. macOS version and hardware compatibility are model-specific.
notes: A bootable USB installer works only on compatible Mac models.
Intel and Apple silicon Macs use different startup procedures.
Some model-specific firmware components may still require internet access.

name: macOS Recovery
description: Built-in Apple recovery environment for supported Macs. Use it to repair storage, restore from Time Machine, or reinstall a compatible macOS version; internet access is generally required for reinstall.
license_note: Use only the recovery version and procedure supported by the exact Mac model.
notes: Not the same as a generic PC USB installer.
Apple silicon and Intel recovery startup steps differ.
Back up before erase or reinstall.

name: iPhone and iPad computer restore
description: Restore or update supported iPhone and iPad devices using Finder on Mac or Apple Devices on Windows. This is a computer-assisted cable workflow, not a bootable pendrive installer.
license_note: Apple firmware and restore procedures are governed by Apple's terms and device eligibility.
notes: Use Finder on Mac or Apple Devices on Windows.
Restore erases device content; create and verify a backup first.
Activation Lock and Apple Account requirements still apply.

name: Android recovery ADB sideload
description: For Android devices whose recovery explicitly supports Apply update from ADB, send a device-compatible signed update package from a connected computer over USB. Support depends on the device build and manufacturer.
license_note: Only use firmware packages authorized for the exact device model, region, and build.
notes: ADB sideload is not a universal Android OS installer.
Only the sideload command works while recovery is in sideload mode.
Never flash a package for a similar-looking but different model.

name: Google Pixel factory images
description: Official factory images for supported Google Pixel models. Manual flashing can restore factory firmware but can erase all user data and may require bootloader unlocking.
license_note: Google device software terms and model-specific restrictions apply.
notes: Select the exact Pixel model and build.
Factory image flashing erases user data; back up first.
Consider the full OTA package where appropriate.

name: Google Pixel full OTA packages
description: Official full OTA packages for supported Pixel and Nexus devices. These can restore or update supported firmware without the factory-image workflow's required wipe or bootloader unlock in documented cases.
license_note: Personal-use and device compatibility restrictions apply; use the exact model and build.
notes: OTA sideload support depends on the exact device and recovery build.
Do not assume Pixel OTA packages work on other Android vendors' devices.

name: Chromebook / ChromeOS recovery
description: Recover supported Chromebooks using built-in internet recovery or Google USB recovery media prepared for the exact Chromebook model.
license_note: Recovery image and device support are controlled by Google and the Chromebook manufacturer.
notes: USB recovery erases local Chromebook storage.
Some newer Chromebooks support internet recovery instead.
Use recovery media for the exact Chromebook model.

name: Raspberry Pi OS and boot media
